title: 9 links that explain why software got crushed today — Salesforce justlost 9%. What's actually driving this?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tuesday's selloff went straight at software. Salesforce fell about 9%,  
and MongoDB, ServiceNow and AppLovin each lost roughly 6% as investors  
dumped AI and enterprise-software risk. Abacus dropped 15% on a  
late-filing notice and Capri almost 9% after its outgoing CEO's stock  
sale. Here's today's overview of the biggest software crashes, and why  
each one fell.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Salesforce (CRM)\*\* — Salesforce dropped -9.11%, falling from the  
prior close of $214.83 to $195.26, with nearly all of the decline  
occurring during regular trading after premarket was only slightly  
lower. The move was driven by a sector-wide de-rating of seat-based  
application software, as investors argued AI agents undermine per-user  
subscription pricing and funds freed up cash ahead of Anthropic's IPO  
and Nvidia's results...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-salesforce-inc-crm-stock-down-8-83-today-39871/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-salesforce-inc-crm-stock-down-8-83-today-39871/)  
  
\*\*2. MongoDB (MDB)\*\* — MongoDB (MDB) dropped -6.08% to $297.64 from  
the prior close of $316.92, with the decline occurring during  
Tuesday's regular session rather than premarket or after-hours. The  
pressure followed quarterly 13F disclosures showing ValueAct Capital  
fully exited its MongoDB position; at roughly $56 million the stake  
was too small to be a fundamental shock on its own, so it amplified an  
existing slide driven by...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-mongodb-inc-mdb-stock-down-6-03-today-39875/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-mongodb-inc-mdb-stock-down-6-03-today-39875/)  
  
\*\*3. ServiceNow (NOW)\*\* — ServiceNow (NOW) dropped -5.91% to $93.50  
from Monday's close of $99.37, with the decline occurring during  
regular-session trading on Nov. 17. The move came from a sector-wide  
AI and enterprise-software selloff as investors cut risk ahead of  
Nvidia's earnings after the close, amplified by Nvidia's leadership  
turmoil and new U.S. restrictions on remote access to advanced AI  
chips via third-country data centers.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-servicenow-inc-now-stock-down-5-91-today-39876/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-servicenow-inc-now-stock-down-5-91-today-39876/)  
  
\*\*4. AppLovin (APP)\*\* — AppLovin fell from Monday's close of $415.22  
to $391.23, a drop of -5.78% (-$23.99), during regular market hours.  
The catalyst was a new wave of analyst price-target trims after the  
post-earnings run: J.P. Morgan reiterated Hold with a $400 target  
below the market price, and RBC cut its target to $500 from $575,  
renewing doubts about near-term upside. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-applovin-app-stock-down-5-75-today-39879/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-applovin-app-stock-down-5-75-today-39879/)  
  
\*\*5. Abacus Global Management (ABX)\*\* — ABX dropped from the Nov 16  
close of $8.65 to $7.35 in the opening minutes of regular trading on  
Nov 17, a move of -15.03% (-$1.30). The trigger was a Form 12b-25  
notice disclosing ABX cannot file its Q3 10-Q while it evaluates  
accounting for capital account credits to private-fund limited  
partners and related-party transactions, with reports back to June 30,  
2025 possibly needing correction.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-abacus-global-management-abx-stock-down-17-46-today-39755/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-abacus-global-management-abx-stock-down-17-46-today-39755/)  
  
\*\*6. Capri Holdings (CPRI)\*\* — CPRI fell from $20.55 to $18.73, a  
\-8.86% move, in early regular-session trading on Nov 17 after gapping  
down from a premarket level near $19.90. The decline extends selling  
that began when outgoing CEO John Idol disclosed the sale of roughly  
2.38 million shares worth about $47 million at $19.47–$20.74,  
unwinding part of a +39% four-week rally built on a Q2 beat, raised  
fiscal 2027 guidance and takeover chatter.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-capri-holdings-limited-cpri-stock-down-7-74-today-39750/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-capri-holdings-limited-cpri-stock-down-7-74-today-39750/)  
  
\*\*7. PicS N.V. (PICS)\*\* — PICS dropped -16.96% in early  
regular-session trading, falling to $5.68 from the prior close of  
$6.84 after opening at $5.79. The move follows third-quarter results  
published after Monday's close: adjusted net profit of R$271 million  
missed the R$289 million consensus, and a shift to 120-day write-offs  
on unsecured personal loans from 360 days triggers a \~R$325 million  
one-off fourth-quarter hit, cutting...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-pics-n-v-pics-stock-down-19-88-today-39752/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-pics-n-v-pics-stock-down-19-88-today-39752/)  
  
\*\*8. Opera (OPRA)\*\* — Opera shares fell from $15.40 to $14.35, a  
\-6.82% drop, in Tuesday's regular session, extending a premarket slide  
that followed the company's third-quarter release. Q3 results beat  
expectations — adjusted EPS of $0.34 versus $0.26 and revenue of  
$182.8 million versus $179.7 million — but full-year 2026 revenue  
guidance of $735–742 million implies a $738.5 million midpoint, just  
below the $740 million consensus.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-opera-limited-opra-stock-down-6-88-today-39749/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-opera-limited-opra-stock-down-6-88-today-39749/)  
  
\*\*9. JD.com (JD)\*\* — JD.com fell -5.88%, sliding from the prior close  
of $27.54 to $25.92, with the decline beginning in premarket trading  
and extending into the regular session after the stock opened down  
more than -6%. The drop followed a mixed third-quarter report released  
before the open: adjusted earnings per ADS of $0.88 missed the $0.98  
consensus, revenue of RMB309.6 billion came in below LSEG's RMB311.48  
billion...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-jd-com-inc-jd-stock-down-5-88-today-39872/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-jd-com-inc-jd-stock-down-5-88-today-39872/)  
  
Which of these software drops matters most into the close, and why?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
